recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-core. Any future displayCategory context change should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack and account for FHIR-43033's ElementDefinition-context decision.
issue_request: FHIR-25127 was a Published/Persuasive R5 FHIR-core Questionnaire request to change questionnaire-displayCategory's contextInvariant from type!='display' to type='display' because the extension is intended for display items.
initial_application: The issue was applied by core commit f0b7244ac8, which changed source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-extension-questionnaire-displayCategory.xml from type!='display' to type='display'. The Jira comment records that commit and the linked Zulip thread confirms the reported contradiction.
additional_context: Commit dd468d4f17 later removed questionnaire extension definitions from the active R5 core source. The active Extension Pack definition now has Questionnaire.item and ElementDefinition contexts and no type!='display' invariant. Later Published FHIR-extensions issue FHIR-43033 and commit 59d4c2c intentionally removed the type='display' invariant while restoring ElementDefinition context because a single Questionnaire.item-oriented invariant could not safely cover both contexts.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. Current core has no active displayCategory extension definition to edit, and reintroducing the old invariant would conflict with later Extension Pack context handling.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue for the same incorrect displayCategory contextInvariant; already represented on the combined branch by a no-change audit.
Published FHIR-extensions context review that removed displayCategory's type='display' invariant while restoring ElementDefinition context after the definition moved out of core.
Same Zulip thread reported display-category terminology wording, but that separate terminology issue is already represented on the combined branch by an external-repo audit.
